Bellingham Walk.road: Narrow footpath/back-lane access with garage blocks; no markings visible.
Bellingham Walk.note: 1960s-70s two-storey terraces in buff/orange brick with brown tile-hung or boarded upper fronts, seen from behind over fences and garage courts; very leafy edges.

Greenleas Avenue.road: Two-lane residential road, no centre line, grass verges, wide pavements.
Greenleas Avenue.note: Mostly detached bungalows and chalet bungalows, red brick or white/cream render, behind low red-brick or stone walls with hedges and garden shrubs.

Yarnton Close.note: 1970s estate detached houses in orange-red brick, some with tile-hung or boarded panels, open-plan lawns, mature trees round the edge.

Jeferson Close.road: Private-feel cul-de-sac, block/tarmac, no markings, no pavement in parts.
Jeferson Close.note: 1990s executive detached houses in red brick with chimneys, double garages and gravel drives, open lawns; dense trees and hedges at the entrance.

Soane End.note: Only one viewpoint loaded; red brick detached houses and a dark-roofed bungalow mostly hidden behind tall hedges and fences.

Spinney Close.road: Quiet residential road, no centre line.
Spinney Close.note: Red-brick two-storey houses with tile roofs, partly hidden by front-garden trees, low stone/brick walls and hedges.

Venetia Close.road: Cul-de-sac with pavements, no markings, block-paved drives.
Venetia Close.note: 1960s-70s semis and detached houses in orange-red brick with white window bands, open front lawns, woodland backdrop.

Putting Green.note: Both viewpoints have no Street View panorama (black screen after retry).

one way.note: Both views have no Street View panorama (black screen after retry); the point is on a path near Highdown School.

Wetherby Close.note: 1960s-70s estate: brick semis with dark tile-hung/boarded upper bands and low buff bungalows, set back behind open lawns and young trees.

St Benets Way.road: Narrow curving estate road, no markings, block-paved edges.
St Benets Way.note: 2000s new-build houses in red brick with some cream render, grey slate-look roofs, chimneys and bay windows, shrubby front strips; heavy greenery.

Fishers Cottages.road: Narrow cul-de-sac with parking court, no markings.
Fishers Cottages.note: 1980s-90s small red-brick houses and starter flats with dark boarded gable panels, brown concrete tile roofs, parking courts and lawn strips.

Albany Gardens.road: Views are at the junction with Highdown Hill Road/Evans Ave: wide road, centre dashes and give-way lines at the junction, broad grass verges.
Albany Gardens.note: Only the junction is visible: interwar white-rendered and red-brick semis behind low brick walls and wide grass verges with big trees.

Gorselands.road: Curving cul-de-sac, no markings, grass verges.
Gorselands.note: 1980s detached houses with dormers and bungalows, all red brick with brown concrete tile roofs, integral garages and open lawns; mature trees around.

Cherry Close.road: Cul-de-sac, no markings, overhead phone wires.
Cherry Close.note: 1960s-70s detached bungalows in red or buff brick plus a few two-storey houses with boarded upper bands; open-plan lawns and drives with garages.

Gayhurst Close.note: 1970s estate semis and short terraces in orange brick with a white boarded or rendered band at first floor, shallow brown tile roofs, open drives.

Penn Close.note: Houses largely hidden by tall hedges; visible ones are buff and red brick postwar semis with chimneys.

Bluebell Gardens.road: New estate road, no markings, block-paved drives.
Bluebell Gardens.note: 2000s new-build red-brick semis and short terraces with gables, dark tile roofs and small open lawns with low post-and-rail edging.

Mallory Avenue.road: Estate road, no markings, block-paved drives to the kerb.
Mallory Avenue.note: 1960s-70s brick semis and short terraces, some with white/cream boarded or rendered first floors, block-paved drives and low brick or fence boundaries.

Eagle Way.note: Both viewpoints have no Street View panorama (black screen after retry).

Caversham Park Drive.road: Junction with Peppard Road: wide road, white edge lines, big trees and railings.
Caversham Park Drive.note: Only the Peppard Road end (black railings, big trees, hedges) and a photosphere of the Caversham Park mansion (pale stone, columned) loaded; no houses on the drive itself were seen.

Autumn Close.note: 1960s-70s houses in buff or red brick with dark-stained weatherboarded first floors, shallow brown tile roofs and open lawns.

Fox Crescent.road: Views are from Kidmore End Road at the entrance: wide road, grass verge, narrow access lane into the crescent.
Fox Crescent.note: Seen only from the entrance: 1990s red-brick detached houses with gables behind thick hedges and big trees.

Aldenham Close.note: 1970s link-detached houses in buff/orange brick with white boarded first-floor panels, integral garages and block-paved open frontages.

Michael King Way.note: No Street View panorama at the viewpoint (black screen after retry).

Lyefield Court.road: Narrow private-style court, block paving, no markings.
Lyefield Court.note: 1990s red-brick gabled houses behind a brick boundary wall and timber fences, with large trees.

Oak Grove.road: narrow lane, no centre line, no pavement on one side
Oak Grove.note: Only a couple of buildings visible: modern red-brick detached house and a long red-brick outbuilding with dark tiled roofs, behind hedges and white picket fence.

Fishers Court.road: short private cul-de-sac / parking court, no markings
Fishers Court.note: 1980s red-brick two-storey flats/terraced block with dark brown tiled roofs, gables with dark hung-tile panels, shrub beds and a tarmac parking court.

Dunster Close.road: narrow cul-de-sac, no centre line, footway on one side, on-street parking
Dunster Close.note: 1960s-70s estate cul-de-sac: red/orange brick two-storey houses with brown concrete-tile roofs and hung-tile upper panels, open lawns and conifer hedges; one view mostly trees.

Barnard Close.road: estate cul-de-sac, no centre line, block-paved drives, give-way line at junction
Barnard Close.note: 1970s estate detached houses in orange and buff brick with brown concrete-tile roofs, attached garages, white uPVC windows and open grass frontages.

Saunders Drive.note: No Street View imagery at the given point (Google says none available); likely a new or private road.

Merthyr Vale.road: narrow modern cul-de-sac, no markings, kerbed with landscaped verges
Merthyr Vale.note: Recent (2000s-2010s) executive detached houses: orange brick ground floors with red hung-tile or white/cream render uppers, dark plain-tile roofs, tall brick chimneys, landscaped open frontages.

Cherwell Road.road: residential road, no centre line, pavements both sides
Cherwell Road.note: 1960s-70s brick detached houses alongside a newly remodelled white-render house with timber-clad gables and grey roof behind a rendered wall; tall laurel hedges hide much of one side.

Langford Close.road: short close off a main road with centre line and wide grass verges; close itself is a small parking spur with no markings
Langford Close.note: Views are mostly the junction: red-brick and part-rendered postwar council-style semis with hipped tiled roofs set behind wide grass verges and trees.

Burleigh Mews.note: Late-1960s/70s detached and link-detached houses in buff and red brick with brown concrete-tile roofs, white uPVC windows, block-paved drives and shrubby open fronts.

Wordsworth Court.road: narrow cul-de-sac with parking court, no markings, footway one side
Wordsworth Court.note: 1980s red-brick two-storey terraces and small flat blocks with dark brown plain-tile roofs, communal lawns, young trees and timber fences around a parking court.

Gayhurst Court.road: estate road/close, no centre line, pavements, on-street parking (Google labels the spot Gayhurst Cl)
Gayhurst Court.note: 1960s-70s estate houses in red brick with brown concrete-tile roofs, some with white-painted upper walls or render panels, integral garages; fronts are a mix of open drives, low brick walls and close-board fences.

Grove Mews.road: small private mews cul-de-sac, block-paved drives, no markings, entered past a red-brick boundary wall
Grove Mews.note: 2000s red-brick two- and three-storey detached and semi houses with dark plain-tile roofs, dormers and white windows, open block-paved frontages; tall red-brick garden wall at the entrance.

Jono View.note: No Street View imagery at the given point (Google says none available); likely a new or private road.

Pilgrims Way.road: narrow modern cul-de-sac, tarmac, no markings, shrub-edged
Pilgrims Way.note: 2000s red-brick houses with grey slate-effect tile roofs, white bay windows with small lean-to roofs over door and bay, a few cream-rendered ones; open lawns and shrubs.

Aldeburgh Close.road: wide quiet cul-de-sac, no centre line, give-way line at mouth, grass verges, overhead wires on poles
Aldeburgh Close.note: Spacious detached houses, many white-rendered Georgian-style with hipped dark tiled roofs and porticos, plus red-brick 1960s-70s detached; broad lawns and block-paved drives.

Cavendish Road.road: back service road behind a shopping parade: no markings, parking area, bins, garages
Cavendish Road.note: Service road behind the shop parade: rear of a 1960s brick parade with flats above and a white-painted fascia band, plus a 1980s red-brick flat block with stone bands; garages and parking.

Birchwood Close.road: estate cul-de-sac, no centre line, footways, mature trees at edges
Birchwood Close.note: 1960s-70s estate houses in buff/yellow brick with brown concrete-tile roofs, white garage doors and open lawns; one view mostly trees and shrubs.

Carisbrooke Close.road: narrow estate cul-de-sac, no markings, shared drives
Carisbrooke Close.note: 1960s-70s estate semis and link-detached houses in orange/brown brick with white-painted or boarded panels under the upper windows, brown concrete-tile roofs, integral garages and open lawns.

Emmer Green Court.road: estate cul-de-sac, no markings, footway, garage block at corner
Emmer Green Court.note: 1970s red-brick two-storey terraces with dark-stained timber/hung-tile panels under the upper windows, brown concrete-tile roofs, open-plan lawns and a brick garage block.

Barnes Road.road: narrow lane with no markings, bollards at a footpath, overgrown verges
Barnes Road.note: Views snapped to a Lyefield Court panorama: a 1980s red-brick sheltered/flat block with dark tiled roofs and tall chimneys, and a white-rendered gabled older house, among big trees and hedges.

Chiltern Court.road: access road / car park with marked bays, no centre line, chain-link fenced playing field alongside
Chiltern Court.note: Not housing at this point: a flat-roofed single-storey white-rendered institutional building (school/community block) with dark brick panels, a small red-brick hipped-roof hut, car park and playing field.

Grove Cottages.road: estate road, no centre line, footways, overhead wires on poles
Grove Cottages.note: Council-style 1960s-70s housing: two-storey red-brick flat blocks with brown tiled roofs behind tall hedges, red-brick terraces, and buff-brick single-storey bungalows/sheltered units; low brick walls and hedges.

Winchendon Place.road: short private access drive off Kidmore End Road, no markings, kerbed entrance with name sign
Winchendon Place.note: Only seen from Kidmore End Road at its entrance: a modern red-brick two/three-storey block with dark tiled roof behind hedges and a parking area; heavy tree cover.

Old Barn Close.road: quiet close, no centre line, footway, close-board fences at the sides
Old Barn Close.note: An old flint-and-brick barn conversion (flint panels with red-brick lacing and quoins, dark plain-tile roof) with a matching flint-and-brick garden wall and clipped yew hedges, plus 1980s red-brick houses with dark tiled roofs and close-board fencing.

Bell Court.road: private gravel/tarmac courtyard behind brick gate piers, no markings
Bell Court.note: 1990s-2000s red-brick cottage-style houses with steep slate roofs and gables round a gravelled courtyard, entered between red-brick piers and walls; a white-rendered older house with red tiles across the lane.

The Crest.road: short spur off a main road (centre line, wide grass verges); The Crest itself has a low name sign and shrubs
The Crest.note: Views are mostly the junction with the main road: red-brick and part-rendered postwar semis with hipped tiled roofs set back behind wide verges and trees; corner plot heavily planted.

Hanover Court.road: estate cul-de-sac, no markings, block-paved drives
Hanover Court.note: Panorama labelled Burleigh Mews (next door): 1960s-70s detached houses in buff and red brick with brown concrete-tile roofs, dark-framed or white windows, flat-roofed garages, open lawns and shrubs.

Chatsworth Close.road: cul-de-sac off a wider estate road with centre line and give-way markings; block-paved drives
Chatsworth Close.note: Views are at the mouth of the close: 1970s buff-brick link houses with brown concrete-tile roofs, white boarded panels upstairs, integral garages and block-paved drives; woodland across the road.
